summary: Pellerin declared solidarity with Israel and JPAC after October 7, calling Hamas actions terrorist attacks, and in January 2024 signed a five-page Jewish Caucus letter expressing personal trauma. She received California Jewish Democrats' strongest 'Strong Support' tier and voted aye on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. Vote for Peace rated her an Ally in the general phase, but her own statements and the Zionist-organization endorsement place the record firmly pro-Israel.
